item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your thoughts shape how the day feels, and you've already set reminders to question your assumptions. Notice when you're guessing what others think and treating it as fact. Notice old negative patterns showing up, and don't feed them. You can choose your perspective, but only if you catch the thought first. Your action: today, when a harsh assumption appears, stop and ask yourself, "What's the evidence?"
